# Named interface default accessors

Unmodified Kotlin/JVM8 output composes a parent compiled with default mode all
and a child compiled with all-compatibility. The inherited default and static
compatibility entries have non-Java method names. A genuine Kotlin caller,
compatibility forwarder, reflection and exact MethodHandle distinguish virtual
receiver dispatch from lexical parent-default dispatch.

Source and SDK-callback profiles compile every recovered Java unit and compare
all original definitions and metadata/Exceptions against individually disclosed
source name bindings, synthetic flag loss and generated helper inventory. Frozen
observers check receiver/token identity, four long values, float raw bits, nulls,
partial effects and exception identity. Independently compiled wrong callbacks
and virtual redispatch challenge the observer.
